items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: I tell my friend that. He’s a drummer and he works with me sometimes.

ctx.x: You’re too young. I tell my friend that. He’s a drummer and he works with me sometimes. And I say, “Do you remember this, Joe?” And he’ll say, “Etta, I was in my playpen then.” So I say, “God will get you for this.”
Can you think of a tune or tunes that you’ve been singing almost from the start of your career that you still do?
